releases.notes:
Update adding support for the latest Tinkers' Construct updates, plus some buffs to blowpipes and some bug fixes to silky cloth.

## Tools

* Added recycling recipe for blockrams.
* Allow laminar shields to receiver banner by @onethirdpirsquaredh in #31.
* Laminar shields no longer support dye, as the dye essentially just added a banner pattern (use banner patterns).
* Laminar armor shield cores can be dyed, for consistency with other armor sets supporting dyes.
* Update multishot recipe on blowpipes.
* Added silky cloth as a new cuirass option for travelers gear.
* Added hematite as a new shell option for slimeshell.
* Fix magmaskin not being cleanable using venom.
* Fix silkitoxin not reducing your current health when equipped.

### Tipped

* Allow blowpipes to receive tipped as a new upgrade.
* Costs 1 upgrade slot per level with a different recipe per level.
* Once tipped, potions can be casted on the blowpipe to select the potion effect, which will be applied to all arrows.
* Like fishing rods, the potion from tipped is not consumed.

## Textures

* Add banner textures for laminar shields by @onethirdpirsquaredh in #31.
* Added new laminar textures by @loafobucket in #25.
* Update generated textures for newer tinkers materials and tools.
* New materials for our tools: nicrosil, knightmetal, cactus, pig iron, jeweled hide, cheese
* New large repair kits: jadeite, horn, slimes, gunpowder, blaze, clay, dragon scale, turtle, vine variants, nauatilus, new slimeskins, wool
* Migrate tool models towards using modifier maps. All tools now expose one you can add textures into (though a few we did not directly create the map JSON, a resource pack or addon can still create them without modifying our models).

## Documentation

* Fix text on laminar shield page overflowing.
* Fix wrong book section for ranged tools.

## Technical

* Migrate away from a few deprecated JSON keys.

releases.notes:
## Additions

### Blockram

* New ancient tool found from skeletons and gifted by toolsmiths.
* Starts with throwing and returning.
* Can break almost any block when thrown, but has 1% mining speed when used for left click harvest.
* Also works as a melee weapon or thrown weapon.

### Magmaskin

* New composite material from pouring magma on leather.
* Can create maille, curiass, bowstrings, and bindings.
* Its trait is overworked, same as plated slimewood. This allows access to the trait on more parts and without brass.

### Silky Cloth

* Now available on fletchings and bowstrings.
* Its trait for both is silkibound, which boosts power in exchange for axis bounding.

## Changes

* Updated generated textures for 3.11.0 Tinkers' Construct update.
* Make hematite liquid in world behave more like lava.
* Added "unknown" bowstring textures.
* Added missing category tags to new materials.
* Ranged (halberd's trait) now is just +1 per level, and properly applies to attack range in both hands.
* Fix wrong drawing animation on shortbows (#15)

## Removals

* Removed veinline, as its trait was redundant to ancient hide. Magmaskin is the new example composite.
* Remove golden modifier from makeshift, as its deprecated in the base mod.

## Full Changelog

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersThings/compare/v1.3.2...v1.3.3

releases.notes:
This update is mostly updates for new features in Tinkers' Construct 3.8.4.

## Knapsack Updates

* Silky Sack is now the Knapsack, featuring a new texture based on the 1.7.10 knapsack
* Change was made due to the new bundles in upcoming Minecraft updates being dyable, so wanted our sack to stand out more.
* Recipe now includes an iron nugget for the buckle.

## Rebalanced (traits)

* All tools support rebalanced (trait) now
* Shovels, short bows, halberds, amethyst staffs, and laminar armor/shields all use one of their tool parts for the trait
* Makeshift armor grants cultivated 2 (+100% repair efficiency)
* Blowpipes grant unburdened 2 (move faster while charging up the blowpipe)
* Chisels get crumbling 2 (+1 mining speed against blocks that don't need a tool, effectively double speed on them)
* Knapsacks (formerly silky sacks) gain stowing (+9 slots)

## Misc

* Casts now have material cost tooltips
* Added stone shield plating to make shield plating gold casts (previously there was no shield plating gold cast)
* Blinding on blowpipes now costs carved pumpkins instead of ink sacs (ink sacs conflicted with nearsighted)
* Added slot layouts to the definition for laminar armor so it shows properly in JEI
* Fix shield plating sand casts not having proper tags, causing them to not be usable in recipes asking for any sand cast
* Fix typo in hematite's encyclopedia description

releases.notes:
## Silky Sack

* New modifiable bag item with 9 inventory slots
* Starts with 0 modifier slots, but they can be added via the usual means to get up to 4 upgrades, 1 ability, and 1 rebalanced
* Every modifier slot can be turned into additional inventory slots

## Laminar Shield

* Mid tier shield between plate and travelers
* Crafted from slimesteel and slimy wood
* Protects against 20 damage at a 130 degree block angle
* Allows moving at 50% speed when blocking
* Like Laminar armor, can receive regrowth as a modifier

## Tools

* Halberds now grant a custom modifier instead of reach. Allows using their extended range in the offhand, and prevents some exploits with their range and other weapons.
* Halberds, chisels, and shovels now have the proper display settings for the blocking modifier
